Vallensbæk is a Danish municipality mentioned once in the corpus within a data table detailing clinical quality metrics for atrial fibrillation treatment [^src1]. Specifically, its data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is included in the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5 on page 94 of the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database [^src1]. No further narrative details, relationships, or claims are available for this entity.
